items.title: Pay outstanding debt collection claim
items.quote: Zahlen Sie den Gesamtbetrag spätestens am Mittwoch, 02.12.2026 auf unser Treuhandkonto.
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar date for payment: Wednesday, 02.12.2026. Checking the calendar, 2026-12-02 is indeed a Wednesday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no weekend/holiday shift under §193 BGB is needed. The due date is simply the date given.

items.title: Dispute the claim in writing, if contested
items.quote: Wenn Sie die Forderung bestreiten, teilen Sie uns das bitte mit Begründung mit; wir klären den Sachverhalt dann mit unserer Auftraggeberin.
items.computation: The letter invites the recipient to dispute the claim with a written justification but gives no explicit deadline for doing so. Since no period or calendar date is stated for this optional action, no exact due date can be computed; practically it should be done before the payment due date (2026-12-02) to avoid further collection steps, but this is not stated as a formal deadline.

warnings: This is a third-party debt collection agency (Inkassobüro) acting for Beispielnetz Kabel GmbH; before paying, verify with the original creditor that the underlying invoices for August and September 2026 are genuinely unpaid and that you did receive the prior Mahnung of 12.10.2026.

The letter names a prior reminder (Mahnung) dated 12.10.2026 but does not attach or quote it; cross-check the referenced original invoices and that reminder with your own records before transferring money.

Double-check the IBAN (DE20 3705 0198 0005 5664 00) and other payment details against official correspondence from Inkassobüro Beispielrecht GmbH before paying, as is good practice whenever a collection agency requests a bank transfer.
